shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,220p' && git log -5 --oneline"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo 'no spec-link reanchor script'; fi && git diff --check && git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "docs: align hook spec status" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
